entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There! That's Takuya Oi. Let's punish[n]this jerk for causing trouble at Akiba!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I didn't do anything wrong! Otakus deserve[n]to be hurt!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That doesn't make any sense!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Otaku or not, it's never okay to hurt people!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Would you shut UP! If you're talking back[n]like that, that means you must be an otaku[n]too!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Otakus should be erased from this world!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: My parents cried when I failed my entrance[n]exam.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: They blamed it on me being an otaku...[n]I took those words to heart.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I was hurt because I was an otaku. If I[n]weren't an otaku, I wouldn't have gotten[n]hurt.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: But my friend passed the exams, so I should[n]have known deep down that it wasn't true.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I ignored the truth. I'm such an idiot...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But you've realized your mistake now, right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Yeah. First... I'm gonna go apologize to that[n]friend.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I don't know if I'll be forgiven, but it's worth[n]a try.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sure, I think that's a good idea!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Also, you need to atone for the things you[n]did.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You hurt a lot of people.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I know.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: My parents are gonna cry again... But that's[n]just the way it has to be.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: It wasn't about whether I was an otaku[n]or not. It was about me being an idiot...
